title: 第一万一百零九章 早在局中第一万一百零八章 无有之相
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：道界天下正文第一万一百零九章早在局中（..la）除去刘鹏和姜影两个身具无有之相的生灵是在姜云的眼前化为光点，被器灵和无相吸收之外，其余具备无有之相生灵消散之时，姜云是身在天地道的功法之中。
因此，他毫不知情。
直至此时此刻，先是天一，接着是夜孤尘的气息，出现在了器灵这术法神通之中，姜云才有所察觉。
天一的消散，姜云虽然有所惊怒，但还不至于动摇他的心神。
毕竟，他和天一之间，交情并不深。
但感应到夜孤尘的气息，对于姜云来说，实在是一个巨大的打击。
夜孤尘和姜云之间的关系，就如同姬空凡一样，亦师亦友，甚至是亦父！
尤其夜孤尘开创炼妖一脉，说他是人族的英雄也不为过。
然而现在，他却悄无声息的化作了器灵的力量之一，更是被器灵用来攻击姜云。
可想而知，姜云心中的悲愤之意！
身在三才之光的笼罩下，姜云没有去抵挡这光芒对自己的侵袭，而是强行按捺住内心的悲愤，仔细感应着光芒之中，那属于夜孤尘的气息。
姜云在尝试着，能否像对待姜影一样，将夜孤尘，也从这光芒之中剥离出来。
然而，器灵根本不给他这个时间，声音再次响起道：“第四相，四象之相！”
青龙、白虎、朱雀、玄武！
四象圣兽的虚影从器灵体内咆哮而出。
虽然只是无有之相所化的虚影，但其中蕴含的力量，却是无比强大。
最重要的是，姜云同样在其中感应到了熟悉的气息。
古之四脉的始祖！
青龙摆尾，撕裂空间；白虎扑击，粉碎法则；朱雀展翅，焚尽万物；玄武镇海，压塌虚无！
四象齐齐扑向了姜云，将他四个方向的退路尽数封死。

面对四象的攻击，姜云反而迅速冷静了下来，站在原地一动不动。
因为到此为此，姜云已经不难推测的出来，曾经赤鼎之中，所有具备无有之相的生灵，肯定已经都被器灵收回。
这些生灵，不管和自己的关系是亲近还是疏离，既然要救，那就将他们全部救出来。
因此，姜云干脆就等着器灵将所有无有之相的攻击施展出来，然后再想办法去救他们！
接下来，器灵的声音果然不停的继续响起。
“第五相，五行之相！”
金木水火土，五行之力是构筑任何一方天地最基本的物质法则。
器灵这一式施展而出，金锐、木生、水柔、火烈、土重——五道截然不同的光芒同时从器灵体内涌出。
它们并非各自为战，而是以五行相生之序首尾相连，化作了一道五彩流转的环形洪流，向着姜云当头罩下。
五行相生，生生不息，这道环形洪流一旦形成便是无始无终的循环，任你力量再强也无法从正面击破。
姜云依旧不为所动，仅仅只是从口中轻轻的吐出两个字：“无伤！”
问道宗内，姜云的同门，一人精通五行之力的天才。
“第六相，六合之相！”
上下四方，谓之六合。
六合之力，是空间的极致，是困锁与封闭最根本的法则。
六道灰白锁链从器灵体内飞出。
它们没有去攻击姜云，而是分作六个方向，钉入了镜中天地的六个方位——天、地、东、南、西、北。
每一根锁链没入虚空的瞬间，整片镜中天地的空间便为之一变。
那些原本可以自由穿梭的空间，褶皱被一根根锁链强行的拉开，摊平，固化。
所有的空间法则都在这一刻失去了灵动与变化，变成了一张密不透风的铁板。

紧接着，锁链开始向着姜云合拢，每收紧一寸，便将姜云可活动的空间压缩一分。
“第七相，七星之相！”
七颗星辰的虚影从器灵体内飞出。
它们并非杂乱无章地悬浮，而是以一种极为精准的排列方式高悬于姜云头顶，构成了七星的形态。
但它们实际上并非是七颗星辰，而是对应着七种情感。
content_en:
Recommended reading for all book friends: Chapter 1109 of the main text of Dao Jie Tian Xia As early as in the game (..la), except for Liu Peng and Jiang Ying, two creatures with the appearance of nothingness, they turned into light spots in front of Jiang Yun's eyes and were absorbed by the weapon spirit and the formlessness. When the other creatures with the appearance of nothingness dissipated, Jiang Yun was in the practice of heaven and earth.
Therefore, he had no idea.
It was not until this moment that Jiang Yun noticed that first the auras of Tianyi and then Ye Guchen appeared in the magical power of the weapon spirit.
Although Jiang Yun was shocked and angry when Tianyi disappeared, it did not shake his mind.
After all, the friendship between him and Tianyi was not deep.
But sensing Ye Guchen's aura was a huge blow to Jiang Yun.
The relationship between Ye Guchen and Jiang Yun is just like that of Ji Kongfan, they are both teachers, friends, and even fathers!
In particular, Ye Guchen created a line of demon refining. It is not an exaggeration to say that he is a hero of the human race.
However, now, he has quietly turned into one of the power of the weapon spirit, and is even used by the weapon spirit to attack Jiang Yun.
One can imagine the sadness and anger in Jiang Yun's heart!
Being shrouded in the light of the Three Talents, Jiang Yun did not resist the invasion of this light. Instead, he suppressed the grief and anger in his heart and carefully sensed the aura belonging to Ye Guchen in the light.
Jiang Yun was trying to see if he could separate Ye Guchen from this light just like he did with Jiang Ying.
However, the weapon spirit did not give him this time at all, and the voice sounded again: "The fourth phase, the phase of the four images!"
Green Dragon, White Tiger, Suzaku, Xuanwu!
The phantoms of the four sacred beasts roared out from the body of the weapon spirit.
Although it is just a shadow transformed from the appearance of nothingness, the power contained in it is extremely powerful.
The most important thing is that Jiang Yun also sensed a familiar atmosphere in it.
The ancestor of the four ancient veins!
The green dragon swung its tail and tore apart the space; the white tiger pounced and shattered the laws; the red bird spread its wings and burned all things; the black basalt suppressed the sea and crushed nothingness!
The four elephants all pounced on Jiang Yun, blocking all his escape routes in four directions.
Facing the attack from Si Xiang, Jiang Yun quickly calmed down and stood motionless.
Because at this point, Jiang Yun could easily deduce that all the creatures with the appearance of nothingness in the red cauldron must have been taken back by the weapon spirit.
Regardless of whether these creatures are close to or distant from him, since he wants to save them, he must save them all.
Therefore, Jiang Yun simply waited for the weapon spirit to unleash all its attacks, and then thought of a way to save them!
Next, the voice of the weapon spirit continued to sound.
"The fifth phase, the phase of the five elements!"
Metal, wood, water, fire, earth, and the power of the five elements are the most basic material laws that build any world.
When the weapon spirit performs this move, five completely different rays of light, namely, golden sharp, woody, water-soft, fire-intense, and earth-heavy, emerge from the weapon spirit's body at the same time.
They did not fight independently, but were connected end to end in the order of the five elements, turning into a colorful circular torrent, covering Jiang Yun's head.
The five elements are interdependent and endless. Once this circular torrent is formed, it will be a cycle without beginning or end. No matter how powerful you are, you cannot break it from the front.
Jiang Yun remained unmoved, and just softly uttered two words from his mouth: "No harm!"
In the Taoist Sect, Jiang Yun's fellow sect is a genius who is proficient in the power of the Five Elements.
"The sixth phase, the phase of Liuhe!"
The four directions above and below are called Liuhe.
The power of Liuhe is the ultimate in space and the most fundamental law of trapping and sealing.
Six gray-white chains flew out of the weapon spirit's body.
They did not attack Jiang Yun, but divided into six directions and nailed the six directions of the heaven and earth in the mirror - heaven, earth, east, south, west, and north.
The moment each chain sank into the void, the entire space of heaven and earth in the mirror changed.
Those who could travel freelyIn the space, the folds were forcibly pulled apart by chains, flattened, and solidified.
All space laws lost their agility and change at this moment, turning into an airtight iron plate.
Immediately afterwards, the chains began to close towards Jiang Yun, and every inch they tightened compressed Jiang Yun's space for movement.
"The seventh phase, the phase of seven stars!"
The phantoms of seven stars flew out from the body of the weapon spirit.
They are not suspended in a haphazard manner, but are suspended above Jiang Yun's head in an extremely precise arrangement, forming the shape of seven stars.
But they are not actually seven stars, but correspond to seven emotions.
